beats.name: Convocation
beats.firedLine: Convocation. The new class is on the lawn.
beats.resolvedLine: The new class is welcomed, at some length.
beats.blurb: The new class files onto the lawn and is told, at some length, that these will be the best years of their lives. Nobody has mentioned the parking.
beats.stub: The year's report card, drawn from the chronicle.
beats.passedLine: Convocation. The new class is welcomed on the lawn, and the year begins.

beats.name: Board Meeting
beats.blurb: The trustees have read the year's numbers, or have had them read to them over lunch. They have views.
beats.stub: The board's view of the rival, and of how the college compares.
beats.passedLine: The board meets, finds the books in order, and adjourns before lunch.

beats.name: Admissions Day
beats.prompt: Admissions Day: the applications are in
beats.firedLine: Admissions Day. The applications are in.
beats.blurb: The applications are in, stacked by a student worker with opinions about the essays. Tuition and selectivity are yours to set; the class that results will simply happen to you.
beats.stub: Prestige, campus beauty and what the guidebooks say, shaping who applies.

beats.name: Budget & Hiring
beats.prompt: The budget is on the desk
beats.firedLine: Budget & Hiring. The ledger is open, and so is the market.
beats.resolvedLine: The budget is approved and the market closes for the year.
beats.blurb: Next year's budget wants approving, and the hiring market is open for the summer. Every candidate is very excited about the opportunity.
